name: Pinecone
note: $0.33/GB-month stored · bulk Import $0.25/GB · upsert billed in Write Units at 1 WU per 1 KB, $4.00/M (Standard) ≈ $3.91/GB · $50/mo minimum. Import is the default path here because it is how a corpus this size actually lands: it reads Parquet out of your own object storage and costs roughly 16x less than upserting the same bytes. It is not an incremental path — an import writes into a new namespace — so live updates and small deltas really do pay the upsert rate, which is what the other button prices.

sources.label: Pinecone pricing
sources.note: Upsert is metered in Write Units (1 WU per 1 KB, 1 KB = 1024 B), which is why this card carries writeUnitBytes rather than a flat per-GB rate. The page quotes Write Units as "$4–$4.50 per million" depending on cloud and region; this card takes the $4.00 floor, so it understates upserts outside the cheapest regions. Import is listed flat at $0.25/GB with no per-request or minimum charge attached.
